// Command seamlessdrill 是分区场景（scene.partition）在生成 game-demo 上的端到端演练客户端：经真实 account 登录、
// 真实玩家 TCP 连接、demo 的协议与同步帧解码（game/clientsync），驱动玩家在两个 Cell 进程之间走动、打怪、互打，
// 由脚本在约定的时刻 kill -9 一个 Cell 进程并重启，最后检查普通场景照常可用。只在独立开发环境运行。
//
//	seamlessdrill -account-nats nats://… -prefix cwdemo -endpoints 1000=…,1001=…,1003=… -ops 1000=…,1001=…,1002=…,1003=… \
//	  -kill 'kill -9 $(cat .dev/game1002.pid)' -restart 'sh restart-1002.sh' -out evidence.json
//
// 每一步打印一行 “STEP <名字> ok …” 或以非零退出并说明哪条断言失败；evidence.json 是各步的计数与观测。
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"MMO_MODULE/game/clientsync"
	"MMO_MODULE/loadtest/playertcp"
	"MMO_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"MMO_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/client/wire"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/frame"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/bus"
	fnats "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/nats"
	natsdriver "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/nats/driver"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
	svcaccount "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/account"
)

const (
	kindSceneActor = entity.EntityKind(6)
	kindMonster    = entity.EntityKind(4)
	// boundary 是两个格的分界线 x（cell_size 3000，2 × 1）。
	boundary = 3000
	// keepRadius：Base 的 Interest 进入半径 120、离开半径 150；离自己这么近的对象被 remove 就算视野不连续
	// （位置按最后一份同步算，留出一帧的位移余量）。
	keepRadius = 130
	// jitterKeepRadius：抖动时 p1 以 300 单位 / 秒来回，客户端看到的自己比服务端晚约 100ms（30 单位）。
	jitterKeepRadius = 100
	// walkerKeepRadius：walker 以 150 单位 / 秒经过 p2，它在客户端的位置晚约 100ms（15 单位）。
	walkerKeepRadius = 115
)

var (
	accountNATS = flag.String("account-nats", "", "NATS url of the account service's bus")
	prefix      = flag.String("prefix", "", "bus prefix")
	endpoints   = flag.String("endpoints", "", "sid=host:port list of player TCP endpoints")
	opsAddrs    = flag.String("ops", "", "sid=host:port list of ops endpoints (GM)")
	token       = flag.String("token", "dev-gm-token", "admin token")
	killCmd     = flag.String("kill", "", "shell command that kill -9s the Cell process of cell (1,0) (sid 1002)")
	restartCmd  = flag.String("restart", "", "shell command that starts sid 1002 again and waits for it to be ready")
	killBase    = flag.String("kill-base", "", "shell command that kill -9s the Base-only process sid 1004")
	restartBase = flag.String("restart-base", "", "shell command that starts sid 1004 again and waits for it to be ready")
	outPath     = flag.String("out", "", "evidence JSON")
	damage      = flag.Int64("damage", 10, "scene.partition.attack_damage")
	expectFail  = flag.String("expect-fail", "", "comma-separated steps known to fail (documented gaps): their failure prints EXPECTED-FAIL and does not fail the drill")
)

type point struct{ X, Y int64 }

func dist(a, b point) int64 {
	return int64(math.Hypot(float64(a.X-b.X), float64(a.Y-b.Y)))
}

// object 是客户端手里的一个对象（合并后的字段）。
type object struct {
	ns      string
	fields  map[string]any
	created time.Time
	updated time.Time
}

func (o object) pos() point {
	return point{X: asInt(o.fields["pos_x"]), Y: asInt(o.fields["pos_y"])}
}

func (o object) hp() int64 {
	if v, ok := o.fields["cell_hp"]; ok {
		return asInt(v)
	}
	return asInt(o.fields["hp"])
}

func asInt(v any) int64 {
	switch t := v.(type) {
	case int64:
		return t
	case int32:
		return int64(t)
	case uint64:
		return int64(t)
	case uint32:
		return int64(t)
	case float64:
		return int64(t)
	case json.Number:
		n, _ := t.Int64()
		return n
	}
	return 0
}

type removal struct {
	ID   int64     `json:"id"`
	At   time.Time `json:"at"`
	Dist int64     `json:"dist"`
	Self point     `json:"self"`
	Obj  point     `json:"obj"`
}

// client 是一个已登录玩家的连接：一个读 goroutine 分发响应（按 seq）与同步帧（按会话解帧，记创建 / 删除）。
type client struct {
	name     string
	sid      int32
	playerID int64
	actorID  int64
	raw      transport.Conn

	mu       sync.Mutex
	seq      uint32
	pending  map[uint32]chan *transport.Packet
	refs     map[frame.ObjectRef]int64
	held     map[int64]*object
	removes  []removal
	creates  map[int64]int
	frames   int
	selfSeen []time.Time
	failure  error
	closed   bool
	// results 是收到的攻击结论推送（AttackResultPush，按到达顺序）。
	results []*pb.AttackResultPush
}

func (c *client) start() {
	go func() {
		for {
			packet, err := c.raw.ReadPacket()
			if err != nil {
				c.mu.Lock()
				c.closed = true
				for _, ch := range c.pending {
					close(ch)
				}
				c.pending = map[uint32]chan *transport.Packet{}
				c.mu.Unlock()
				return
			}
			if packet.Flags&wire.FlagSync != 0 && packet.MsgID == msgid.MsgEntitySync {
				c.consume(packet.Payload)
				continue
			}
			if packet.MsgID == msgid.MsgAttackResult {
				if push, err := pb.UnmarshalAttackResultPush(packet.Payload); err == nil {
					c.mu.Lock()
					c.results = append(c.results, push)
					c.mu.Unlock()
				}
				continue
			}
			c.mu.Lock()
			ch := c.pending[packet.Seq]
			delete(c.pending, packet.Seq)
			c.mu.Unlock()
			if ch != nil {
				ch <- packet
			}
		}
	}()
}

func (c *client) consume(payload []byte) {
	decoded, err := entitysync.DecodeFrame(payload, frame.DefaultLimits())
	now := time.Now()
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if err != nil {
		c.failure = fmt.Errorf("%s: decode frame: %w", c.name, err)
		return
	}
	c.frames++
	for _, obj := range decoded.Objects {
		subject := c.refs[obj.Ref]
		fields := map[string]any{}
		ns := ""
		for _, component := range obj.Components {
			update, err := entitysync.DecodeSubjectUpdate(component.Data, 0)
			if err != nil {
				c.failure = fmt.Errorf("%s: decode update: %w", c.name, err)
				return
			}
			subject, ns = update.SubjectID, update.Namespace
			if len(update.Payload.BytesCopy()) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			doc, err := clientsync.DecodeFields(update)
			if err != nil {
				c.failure = fmt.Errorf("%s: decode fields: %w", c.name, err)
				return
			}
			for k, v := range doc {
				fields[k] = v
			}
		}
		// 自己的 SceneActor：ID 是 BuildEntityID(玩家 ID, SceneActor)。本进程没有登记实体种类，按 kind 与 unique 认。
		if c.actorID == 0 && entity.GetEntityKindFromID(subject) == kindSceneActor && entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(subject) == c.playerID {
			c.actorID = subject
		}
		switch obj.Operation {
		case frame.ObjectCreate:
			c.refs[obj.Ref] = subject
			c.held[subject] = &object{ns: ns, fields: fields, created: now, updated: now}
			c.creates[subject]++
		case frame.ObjectUpdate:
			o := c.held[subject]
			if o == nil {
				o = &object{ns: ns, fields: map[string]any{}, created: now}
				c.held[subject] = o
			}
			for k, v := range fields {
				o.fields[k] = v
			}
			o.updated = now
		case frame.ObjectRemove:
			r := removal{ID: subject, At: now}
			if o := c.held[subject]; o != nil {
				r.Obj = o.pos()
			}
			if self := c.held[c.actorID]; self != nil {
				r.Self = self.pos()
				r.Dist = dist(r.Self, r.Obj)
			}
			c.removes = append(c.removes, r)
			delete(c.refs, obj.Ref)
			delete(c.held, subject)
		}
		if subject == c.actorID && (obj.Operation == frame.ObjectCreate || obj.Operation == frame.ObjectUpdate) {
			c.selfSeen = append(c.selfSeen, now)
		}
	}
}

func (c *client) call(ctx context.Context, id uint32, payload []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	if c.closed {
		c.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: connection closed", c.name)
	}
	c.seq++
	seq := c.seq
	ch := make(chan *transport.Packet, 1)
	c.pending[seq] = ch
	c.mu.Unlock()
	if err := c.raw.WritePackets([]*transport.Packet{{MsgID: id, Seq: seq, Payload: payload}}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	select {
	case packet, ok := <-ch:
		if !ok {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: connection closed while waiting for msg %d", c.name, id)
		}
		return packet.Payload, nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: no response to msg %d", c.name, id)
	}
}

// snapshot 是客户端此刻手里的对象（拷贝）。
func (c *client) snapshot() map[int64]object {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	out := make(map[int64]object, len(c.held))
	for id, o := range c.held {
		copied := *o
		copied.fields = map[string]any{}
		for k, v := range o.fields {
			copied.fields[k] = v
		}
		out[id] = copied
	}
	return out
}

// describe 列出客户端手里的对象（失败信息用）。
func (c *client) describe() string {
	var parts []string
	for id, o := range c.snapshot() {
		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d(kind %d %s %v)", id, entity.GetEntityKindFromID(id), o.ns, o.fields))
	}
	sort.Strings(parts)
	return strings.Join(parts, " ")
}

func (c *client) self() (object, bool) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	id := c.actorID
	c.mu.Unlock()
	o, ok := c.snapshot()[id]
	return o, ok
}

func (c *client) removalsSince(t time.Time) []removal {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	var out []removal
	for _, r := range c.removes {
		if !r.At.Before(t) {
			out = append(out, r)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func (c *client) err() error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return c.failure
}

func must[T any](v T, err error) T {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return v
}

func pairs(list string) map[int32]string {
	out := map[int32]string{}
	for _, pair := range strings.Split(list, ",") {
		key, value, ok := strings.Cut(strings.TrimSpace(pair), "=")
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		sid, _ := strconv.Atoi(key)
		out[int32(sid)] = value
	}
	return out
}

func accounts() (*svcaccount.BusClient, func(), error) {
	assembly, err := natsdriver.Assemble(fnats.DefaultConfig(*accountNATS), natsdriver.ClientOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	b := bus.New(assembly.Client, assembly.RPC, nil, bus.Config{SvcType: "seamlessdrill", Prefix: *prefix, WorkerNum: 2, QueueCap: 64})
	if err := b.Start(); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	client, err := svcaccount.NewBusClient(b, "", 0)
	if err != nil {
		b.Stop()
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return client, b.Stop, nil
}

// login 经 account 登录、建角色、选角色，连上 sid 的玩家 TCP，EnterGame，装好解码器后 SceneReady。
func login(ctx context.Context, accounts *svcaccount.BusClient, name string, sid int32, nonce string) (*client, error) {
	openID := "seamless-" + nonce + "-" + name
	account, err := accounts.Login(ctx, svcaccount.Identity{Channel: "demo", OpenID: openID, Credential: "demo:" + openID})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("login %s: %w", name, err)
	}
	role, err := accounts.CreateRole(ctx, account.ID, sid, "sl_"+name+"_"+nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create role %s: %w", name, err)
	}
	session, err := accounts.SelectRole(ctx, account.ID, role.PlayerID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("select role %s: %w", name, err)
	}
	endpoint := pairs(*endpoints)[sid]
	if endpoint == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no endpoint for sid %d", sid)
	}
	raw, err := transport.Dial(ctx, transport.Config{Type: playertcp.TransportType, Endpoint: endpoint, DialTimeout: 5 * time.Second})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	c := &client{name: name, sid: sid, playerID: role.PlayerID, raw: raw,
		pending: map[uint32]chan *transport.Packet{}, refs: map[frame.ObjectRef]int64{}, held: map[int64]*object{}, creates: map[int64]int{}}
	if err := raw.WritePackets([]*transport.Packet{playertcp.AuthPacket(fmt.Sprintf("session:%d:%s", role.PlayerID, session.Token))}); err != nil {
		raw.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	c.start()
	resp, err := c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgEnterGame, must(pb.MarshalEnterGameRequest(&pb.EnterGameRequest{ClientVersion: "seamlessdrill"})))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	entered, err := pb.UnmarshalEnterGameResponse(resp)
	if err != nil || entered.Code != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("enter game %s: %v %+v", name, err, entered)
	}
	ready, err := c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgSceneReady, must(pb.MarshalSceneReadyRequest(&pb.SceneReadyRequest{})))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if r, err := pb.UnmarshalSceneReadyResponse(ready); err != nil || r.Code != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("scene ready %s: %v %+v", name, err, r)
	}
	return c, nil
}

func (c *client) moveIntent(ctx context.Context, vx, vy int64) error {
	resp, err := c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgMoveIntent, must(pb.MarshalMoveIntentRequest(&pb.MoveIntentRequest{VX: vx, VY: vy})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r, err := pb.UnmarshalMoveIntentResponse(resp)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if r.Code != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s move_intent (%d,%d): code %d %s", c.name, vx, vy, r.Code, r.Reason)
	}
	return nil
}

func (c *client) attack(ctx context.Context, target int64) (uint64, error) {
	resp, err := c.call(ctx, msgid.MsgAttackTarget, must(pb.MarshalAttackTargetRequest(&pb.AttackTargetRequest{Target: target})))
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	r, err := pb.UnmarshalAttackTargetResponse(resp)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if r.Code != 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s attack_target %d: code %d %s", c.name, target, r.Code, r.Reason)
	}
	return r.Seq, nil
}

// waitFor polls cond every 50ms until it holds or the timeout passes.
func waitFor(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, what string, cond func() (bool, string)) error {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	last := ""
	for {
		ok, detail := cond()
		if ok {
			return nil
		}
		last = detail
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: not reached within %s (%s)", what, timeout, last)
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		case <-time.After(50 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
}

// walkTo 以速度 speed 走向 x（只沿 X），到了停下；走动期间检查自己的同步不断档。
func (c *client) walkTo(ctx context.Context, x, y int64, speed int64) error {
	self, ok := c.self()
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: does not see itself", c.name)
	}
	from := self.pos()
	dx, dy := x-from.X, y-from.Y
	length := math.Hypot(float64(dx), float64(dy))
	if length < 5 {
		return nil
	}
	vx := int64(float64(dx) / length * float64(speed))
	vy := int64(float64(dy) / length * float64(speed))
	if err := c.moveIntent(ctx, vx, vy); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	err := waitFor(ctx, time.Duration(length/float64(speed)*float64(time.Second))+5*time.Second, c.name+" walk", func() (bool, string) {
		s, ok := c.self()
		if !ok {
			return false, "self not seen"
		}
		p := s.pos()
		remaining := (x-p.X)*vx + (y-p.Y)*vy
		return remaining <= 0, fmt.Sprintf("at %v", p)
	})
	if stopErr := c.moveIntent(ctx, 0, 0); err == nil {
		err = stopErr
	}
	return err
}

// gm runs one GM command on the process of sid.
func gm(ctx context.Context, sid int32, name string, payload any) (map[string]any, error) {
	addr := pairs(*opsAddrs)[sid]
	body := map[string]any{"name": name}
	if payload != nil {
		body["payload"] = payload
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(body)
	request, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "http://"+addr+"/admin/execute", bytes.NewReader(raw))
	request.Header.Set("X-Admin-Token", *token)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	data, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	var result struct {
		OK      bool           `json:"ok"`
		Message string         `json:"message"`
		Data    map[string]any `json:"data"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.UseNumber() // 实体 ID 超过 2^53，按 float64 解会丢位
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gm %s on %d: %s: %w", name, sid, data, err)
	}
	if !result.OK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gm %s on %d: %s", name, sid, result.Message)
	}
	return result.Data, nil
}

func nodeStat(stats map[string]any, key string) int64 {
	node, _ := stats["node"].(map[string]any)
	return asInt(node[key])
}

func attackStat(stats map[string]any, key string) int64 {
	attacks, _ := stats["attacks"].(map[string]any)
	return asInt(attacks[key])
}

// cellEntities lists the region entries of a Cell process (gm.scene.partition).
func cellEntities(ctx context.Context, sid int32) ([]map[string]any, error) {
	stats, err := gm(ctx, sid, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	raw, _ := stats["entities"].([]any)
	out := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(raw))
	for _, item := range raw {
		if m, ok := item.(map[string]any); ok {
			out = append(out, m)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func roleIn(entities []map[string]any, id int64) string {
	for _, e := range entities {
		if asInt(e["id"]) == id {
			s, _ := e["role"].(string)
			return s
		}
	}
	return ""
}

var evidence = map[string]any{}

func step(name string, detail map[string]any) {
	evidence[name] = detail
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(detail)
	fmt.Printf("STEP %s ok %s\n", name, raw)
}

// nearbyRemovals 是 since 之后 c 在 radius 以内丢掉的对象（视野不连续）。距离按客户端最后一份同步算，比服务端
// 判断时的位置晚一两帧：走得越快余量越大（keepRadius 用于 ≤ 150 单位 / 秒，快速抖动用更小的半径）。
func nearbyRemovals(c *client, since time.Time, radius int64) []removal {
	var bad []removal
	for _, r := range c.removalsSince(since) {
		if r.Dist <= radius {
			bad = append(bad, r)
		}
	}
	return bad
}

// selfGap 是 since 之后 c 自己的同步更新的最大间隔。
func selfGap(c *client, since time.Time) time.Duration {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	var worst time.Duration
	last := since
	for _, t := range c.selfSeen {
		if t.Before(since) {
			continue
		}
		worst = max(worst, t.Sub(last))
		last = t
	}
	return max(worst, time.Since(last))
}

func monstersNear(c *client, at point, radius int64) []int64 {
	var ids []int64
	for id, o := range c.snapshot() {
		if entity.GetEntityKindFromID(id) == kindMonster && dist(o.pos(), at) <= radius {
			ids = append(ids, id)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(ids, func(i, j int) bool { return ids[i] < ids[j] })
	return ids
}

func shell(command string) error {
	cmd := exec.Command("sh", "-c", command)
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr, os.Stderr
	return cmd.Run()
}

func main() {
	playertcp.MustRegister()
	flag.Parse()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	err := run(ctx)
	if *outPath != "" {
		raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(evidence, "", "  ")
		_ = os.WriteFile(*outPath, append(raw, '\n'), 0o644)
	}
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "seamlessdrill: FAIL: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("seamlessdrill: all steps passed")
}

func run(ctx context.Context) error {
	accountsClient, stop, err := accounts()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer stop()
	nonce := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano()%1_000_000_000, 36)

	// 1. 登录 → 进分区场景：p1、p2 的 Base 是 sid 1000（不托管格的进程），p3 的 Base 是 sid 1001（同时是格 (0,0) 的 Cell）。
	p1, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "p1", 1000, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	p2, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "p2", 1000, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	p3, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "p3", 1001, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	clients := []*client{p1, p2, p3}
	for _, c := range clients {
		c := c
		if err := waitFor(ctx, 10*time.Second, c.name+" sees itself", func() (bool, string) {
			s, ok := c.self()
			return ok && s.hp() > 0, fmt.Sprintf("self %d held %s err %v", c.actorID, c.describe(), c.err())
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	self1, _ := p1.self()
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "p1 sees monsters near the border", func() (bool, string) {
		ids := monstersNear(p1, self1.pos(), keepRadius)
		return len(ids) >= 2, fmt.Sprint(ids)
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// 普通移动协议在分区场景里被拒（D6 = A）。
	moveResp, err := p1.call(ctx, msgid.MsgMove, must(pb.MarshalMoveRequest(&pb.MoveRequest{X: 1, Y: 1})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if r, _ := pb.UnmarshalMoveResponse(moveResp); r == nil || r.Code != 100024 {
		return fmt.Errorf("move in a partitioned scene: want scene_partitioned, got %+v", r)
	}
	step("enter", map[string]any{"p1": p1.playerID, "p2": p2.playerID, "p3": p3.playerID, "p1_at": self1.pos(), "p1_hp": self1.hp(),
		"monsters_near_p1": monstersNear(p1, self1.pos(), keepRadius), "move_refused": "scene_partitioned"})

	// E4：分区场景里自己的 Player 字段（exp 等）经自身视图走同一条连接：AddExp 之后客户端看到自己的 exp 变了；
	// SceneActor 的 mirror 不带这些字段。
	soft("own_state", func() error {
		var before int64
		if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "p1 holds its own Player", func() (bool, string) {
			o, ok := p1.ownPlayer()
			before = asInt(o.fields["exp"])
			return ok, p1.describe()
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		resp, err := p1.call(ctx, msgid.MsgAddExp, must(pb.MarshalAddExpRequest(&pb.AddExpRequest{Amount: 7})))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if r, err := pb.UnmarshalAddExpResponse(resp); err != nil || r.Code != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("add_exp: %v %+v", err, r)
		}
		if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "p1 sees its exp change", func() (bool, string) {
			o, _ := p1.ownPlayer()
			return asInt(o.fields["exp"]) == before+7, fmt.Sprintf("exp %v want %d", o.fields["exp"], before+7)
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if s, ok := p1.self(); ok {
			if _, carries := s.fields["exp"]; carries {
				return fmt.Errorf("the scene actor's mirror carries exp: %v", s.fields)
			}
		}
		step("own_state", map[string]any{"exp_before": before, "exp_after": before + 7})
		return nil
	}())

	// p2 走到格 (1,0) 里靠边的位置站着（他是 p1 的“附近的其它玩家”，也是之后崩溃重建的对象）；p3 留在格 (0,0)。
	if err := p2.walkTo(ctx, 3060, 1530, 200); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := p3.walkTo(ctx, 2940, 1470, 200); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	base0, _ := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	cellA0, _ := gm(ctx, 1001, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	cellB0, _ := gm(ctx, 1002, "gm.scene.partition", nil)

	// 2. 直线跨界：p1 从格 (0,0) 走进格 (1,0) 再走回来。附近的怪与其它玩家（p2、p3）在他的客户端里不被 remove。
	since := time.Now()
	// 走到格 (1,0) 里（过了 3000 + H，交给 sid 1002），此时 p2（Base 同在 sid 1000）就在旁边；走回格 (0,0) 后 p3
	// （Base 在 sid 1001）在旁边。两头各确认一次手里有对方。
	if err := p1.walkTo(ctx, 3150, 1500, 100); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, ok := p1.snapshot()[p2.actorID]; !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("straight crossing: p1 in cell (1,0) does not hold p2: %s", p1.describe())
	}
	if err := p1.walkTo(ctx, 2850, 1500, 100); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, ok := p1.snapshot()[p3.actorID]; !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("straight crossing: p1 back in cell (0,0) does not hold p3: %s", p1.describe())
	}
	if bad := nearbyRemovals(p1, since, keepRadius); len(bad) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("straight crossing: p1 lost nearby objects %+v", bad)
	}
	gap := selfGap(p1, since)
	if gap > 500*time.Millisecond {
		return fmt.Errorf("straight crossing: p1's own state stalled %s", gap)
	}
	base1, _ := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	step("straight", map[string]any{"owner_changes": nodeStat(base1, "OwnerChanges") - nodeStat(base0, "OwnerChanges"),
		"self_gap_ms": gap.Milliseconds(), "nearby_removed": 0, "creates_p2": p1.createCount(p2.actorID)})

	// 3. 抖动：在分界线两侧每 300ms 换向，约 4s。
	since = time.Now()
	before := nodeStat(base1, "OwnerChanges")
	// 从 2900 起，以 300 单位 / 秒每 0.67s 换向（每段 200）：每段都越过对面格的迟滞线（3050 / 2950），来回交接。
	if err := p1.walkTo(ctx, 2900, 1500, 150); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for i := range 8 {
		v := int64(300)
		if i%2 == 1 {
			v = -300
		}
		if err := p1.moveIntent(ctx, v, 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		time.Sleep(667 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	if err := p1.moveIntent(ctx, 0, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
	if bad := nearbyRemovals(p1, since, jitterKeepRadius); len(bad) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("jitter: p1 lost nearby objects %+v", bad)
	}
	gap = selfGap(p1, since)
	base2, _ := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	if gap > 500*time.Millisecond {
		return fmt.Errorf("jitter: p1's own state stalled %s", gap)
	}
	if changes := nodeStat(base2, "OwnerChanges") - before; changes < 4 {
		return fmt.Errorf("jitter: only %d owner changes", changes)
	}
	step("jitter", map[string]any{"owner_changes": nodeStat(base2, "OwnerChanges") - before, "self_gap_ms": gap.Milliseconds()})

	// 4. 斜穿：沿对角线穿过分界线（2 × 1 的网格没有四格交点，四格交点在框架的进程内用例里）。
	since = time.Now()
	if err := p1.walkTo(ctx, 3120, 1620, 120); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := p1.walkTo(ctx, 2880, 1380, 120); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if bad := nearbyRemovals(p1, since, keepRadius); len(bad) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("diagonal: p1 lost nearby objects %+v", bad)
	}
	gap = selfGap(p1, since)
	if gap > 500*time.Millisecond {
		return fmt.Errorf("diagonal: p1's own state stalled %s", gap)
	}
	step("diagonal", map[string]any{"self_gap_ms": gap.Milliseconds()})

	// 5. 跨界打怪：p1 站在格 (0,0)，打格 (1,0) 里一只静止的怪 10 次；再站到格 (1,0) 打格 (0,0) 的怪 10 次。
	//    结论按 Base 的计数核对，HP 按客户端看到的核对：HP 下降 = 伤害 × 结算数，且每次都结算了。
	type hitPlan struct {
		stand  point
		target func() int64
	}
	plans := []hitPlan{
		// 格 (0,0) 里（从未越过 3000 - H）打格 (1,0) 的怪（3010..3040）。
		{stand: point{2950, 1500}, target: func() int64 { return pickMonster(p1, func(p point) bool { return p.X >= boundary && p.X < boundary+100 }) }},
		// 走过 3000 + H 交给格 (1,0) 后打格 (0,0) 的怪（2960..2990）。
		{stand: point{3070, 1500}, target: func() int64 { return pickMonster(p1, func(p point) bool { return p.X < boundary && p.X > boundary-100 }) }},
	}
	for i, plan := range plans {
		if err := p1.walkTo(ctx, plan.stand.X, plan.stand.Y, 100); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
		target := plan.target()
		if target == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("attack %d: no monster across the border in p1's view", i)
		}
		startHP := p1.snapshot()[target].hp()
		// 第 3 项 = A：伤害是 p1 的 Real 上面板的攻击（客户端从自己 SceneActor 的 mirror 看到 cell_attack）。
		atk := attackOf(p1)
		statsBefore, _ := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
		forwardedBefore := cellsStat(ctx, "DamageForwarded")
		const n = 10
		var firstSeq, lastSeq uint64
		for k := range n {
			seq, err := p1.attack(ctx, target)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if k == 0 {
				firstSeq = seq
			}
			lastSeq = seq
			time.Sleep(30 * time.Millisecond)
		}
		var statsAfter map[string]any
		if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "attack verdicts", func() (bool, string) {
			statsAfter, _ = gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
			got := attackStat(statsAfter, "applied") + attackStat(statsAfter, "rejected") + attackStat(statsAfter, "unknown") -
				attackStat(statsBefore, "applied") - attackStat(statsBefore, "rejected") - attackStat(statsBefore, "unknown")
			return got >= n, fmt.Sprintf("verdicts %d", got)
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		applied := attackStat(statsAfter, "applied") - attackStat(statsBefore, "applied")
		if applied != n {
			return fmt.Errorf("attack %d: %d of %d applied (%v)", i, applied, n, statsAfter["attacks"])
		}
		wantHP := max(0, startHP-atk*applied)
		if err := waitFor(ctx, 3*time.Second, "target hp on the client", func() (bool, string) {
			o, ok := p1.snapshot()[target]
			return ok && o.hp() == wantHP, fmt.Sprintf("hp %d want %d", o.hp(), wantHP)
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// 第 2 项：每一次攻击的结论都推到攻击方客户端：applied、伤害、目标 HP 逐次下降到客户端同步里看到的值。
		soft(fmt.Sprintf("attack_results_%d", i), waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "attack results pushed to the attacker", func() (bool, string) {
			got := p1.resultsFor(firstSeq, lastSeq)
			if len(got) < n {
				return false, fmt.Sprintf("%d of %d pushes", len(got), n)
			}
			minHP := int32(math.MaxInt32)
			for _, r := range got {
				if r.Target != target || r.Outcome != "applied" || int64(r.Damage) != atk {
					return false, fmt.Sprintf("push %+v", r)
				}
				minHP = min(minHP, r.TargetHP)
			}
			return int64(minHP) == wantHP, fmt.Sprintf("lowest pushed hp %d want %d", minHP, wantHP)
		}))
		step(fmt.Sprintf("attack_across_%d", i), map[string]any{"target": target, "start_hp": startHP, "end_hp": wantHP, "damage": atk,
			"pushed_results": len(p1.resultsFor(firstSeq, lastSeq)),
			"applied": applied, "duplicate": attackStat(statsAfter, "duplicate") - attackStat(statsBefore, "duplicate"),
			"damage_forwarded_by_cells": cellsStat(ctx, "DamageForwarded") - forwardedBefore,
			"damage_retries_total": cellsStat(ctx, "DamageRetries")})
	}

	// 第 3 项 = A：战斗面板的权威在 Cell 的 Real。p1 升一级（AddExp 一级的经验）：Base 在同一笔事务里推出新面板、提交后发给
	// 当前 owner；客户端从自己 SceneActor 的 mirror 看到 cell_max_hp / cell_attack 变大、当前 HP 不回血；自己 Player 的
	// self 视图里没有另一份 HP / 面板；之后打怪一次，伤害是新的攻击值。
	soft("panel_level_up", func() error {
		self, ok := p1.self()
		if !ok {
			return errors.New("p1 does not see itself")
		}
		maxBefore, atkBefore, hpBefore := asInt(self.fields["cell_max_hp"]), attackOf(p1), self.hp()
		if maxBefore <= 0 || atkBefore != *damage {
			return fmt.Errorf("before the level-up: cell_max_hp %d cell_attack %d, want a panel with the level-0 attack %d", maxBefore, atkBefore, *damage)
		}
		resp, err := p1.call(ctx, msgid.MsgAddExp, must(pb.MarshalAddExpRequest(&pb.AddExpRequest{Amount: 100})))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if r, err := pb.UnmarshalAddExpResponse(resp); err != nil || r.Code != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("add_exp: %v %+v", err, r)
		}
		var maxAfter, atkAfter int64
		if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "p1's scene actor shows the new panel", func() (bool, string) {
			s, _ := p1.self()
			maxAfter, atkAfter = asInt(s.fields["cell_max_hp"]), attackOf(p1)
			return maxAfter > maxBefore && atkAfter > atkBefore, fmt.Sprintf("cell_max_hp %d cell_attack %d", maxAfter, atkAfter)
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if s, _ := p1.self(); s.hp() != hpBefore {
			return fmt.Errorf("the level-up healed: cell_hp %d -> %d (the panel changes the cap only)", hpBefore, s.hp())
		}
		own, ok := p1.ownPlayer()
		if !ok {
			return errors.New("p1 does not hold its own Player")
		}
		for _, key := range []string{"cell_hp", "cell_max_hp", "cell_attack", "cell_power", "attr_final", "attr_base"} {
			if _, has := own.fields[key]; has {
				return fmt.Errorf("p1's own Player view carries %s (fields %v): a second copy of the HP / panel", key, own.fields)
			}
		}
		state, err := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": p1.playerID})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "the base sees the panel confirmed", func() (bool, string) {
			state, _ = gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": p1.playerID})
			return asInt(state["panel_ver"]) > 0 && asInt(state["panel_acked"]) == asInt(state["panel_ver"]) && asInt(state["attack"]) == atkAfter,
				fmt.Sprintf("%v", state)
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		here, _ := p1.self()
		target := pickMonster(p1, func(p point) bool { return dist(p, here.pos()) <= 120 })
		if target == 0 {
			return errors.New("no monster near p1 to hit after the level-up")
		}
		startHP := p1.snapshot()[target].hp()
		seq, err := p1.attack(ctx, target)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		wantHP := max(0, startHP-atkAfter)
		if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "one hit at the new attack", func() (bool, string) {
			got := p1.resultsFor(seq, seq)
			o := p1.snapshot()[target]
			return len(got) == 1 && got[0].Outcome == "applied" && int64(got[0].Damage) == atkAfter && o.hp() == wantHP,
				fmt.Sprintf("pushes %+v hp %d want %d", got, o.hp(), wantHP)
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		step("panel_level_up", map[string]any{"cell_max_hp_before": maxBefore, "cell_max_hp_after": maxAfter, "cell_attack_before": atkBefore,
			"cell_attack_after": atkAfter, "cell_hp": hpBefore, "base_panel": state, "hit_target": target, "hit_damage": atkAfter,
			"target_hp": []int64{startHP, wantHP}})
		return nil
	}())

	// 6. Monster 跨界：配置里有一只沿 +X / -X 往返的怪（walker，150 单位 / 秒，碰世界边缘反弹，约每 40s 过一次分界线）。
	//    p2 站到它过线的位置旁边，等它从一个格交给另一个格（旧格 Real → 新格 Real），期间 p2 的客户端一直持有它。
	walker, owner, walkerY, err := findWalker(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := p2.walkTo(ctx, boundary, walkerY+40, 200); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	since = time.Now()
	var sawWalker time.Time
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 60*time.Second, "walker handed to the other cell", func() (bool, string) {
		if o, ok := p2.snapshot()[walker]; ok {
			if self, ok := p2.self(); ok && dist(o.pos(), self.pos()) <= 100 && sawWalker.IsZero() {
				sawWalker = time.Now()
			}
		}
		a, _ := cellEntities(ctx, 1001)
		b, _ := cellEntities(ctx, 1002)
		now := map[int32]string{1001: roleIn(a, walker), 1002: roleIn(b, walker)}
		other := int32(1001)
		if owner == 1001 {
			other = 1002
		}
		return now[other] == "real" && now[owner] != "real" && !sawWalker.IsZero(), fmt.Sprintf("roles %v seen %v", now, !sawWalker.IsZero())
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if bad := nearbyRemovals(p2, since, walkerKeepRadius); len(bad) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("monster crossing: p2 lost nearby objects %+v", bad)
	}
	cellA1, _ := gm(ctx, 1001, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	cellB1, _ := gm(ctx, 1002, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	step("monster_cross", map[string]any{"walker": walker, "from_sid": owner, "creates_on_p2": p2.createCount(walker),
		"handoffs_accepted_cell_a": nodeStat(cellA1, "HandoffsAccepted") - nodeStat(cellA0, "HandoffsAccepted"),
		"handoffs_accepted_cell_b": nodeStat(cellB1, "HandoffsAccepted") - nodeStat(cellB0, "HandoffsAccepted")})
	if err := p2.walkTo(ctx, 3060, 1530, 200); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// 7. kill -9 一个 Cell 进程（格 (1,0)，sid 1002）后玩家重进、HP 按快照恢复：p1 先打 p2 两下（HP 100 → 80），等回写
	//    进 Player（Base 进程 sid 1000）；kill -9 sid 1002 再重启，p2 的 Base 静默看门狗重进，新的 SceneActor 按快照建出。
	// p1 回到格 (0,0)（越过 3000 - H），这样被杀的只有 p2 所在的格。
	if err := p1.walkTo(ctx, 2930, 1520, 100); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
	p2Self, _ := p2.self()
	for range 2 {
		if _, err := p1.attack(ctx, p2.actorID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	wantHP := p2Self.hp() - 2*attackOf(p1)
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 10*time.Second, "p2's hp written back to its Player", func() (bool, string) {
		state, err := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": p2.playerID})
		if err != nil {
			return false, err.Error()
		}
		return asInt(state["hp"]) == wantHP && asInt(state["snapshot_seq"]) > 0, fmt.Sprintf("%v", state)
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	before7, _ := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": p2.playerID})
	if *killCmd == "" || *restartCmd == "" {
		return errors.New("-kill and -restart are required")
	}
	// 崩溃期间每 500ms 记一次 Base 眼里的 p2（证据与排查用）。
	var trace []map[string]any
	traceDone := make(chan struct{})
	traceStop := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(traceDone)
		for {
			select {
			case <-traceStop:
				return
			case <-time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):
			}
			if state, err := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": p2.playerID}); err == nil {
				state["at"] = time.Now().Format("15:04:05.000")
				trace = append(trace, state)
			}
		}
	}()
	defer func() {
		select {
		case <-traceStop:
		default:
			close(traceStop)
		}
		<-traceDone
		evidence["cell_crash_trace"] = trace
	}()
	killedAt := time.Now()
	if err := shell(*killCmd); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("kill: %w", err)
	}
	if err := shell(*restartCmd); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("restart: %w", err)
	}
	restartedAt := time.Now()
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 30*time.Second, "p2 re-entered with its snapshot hp", func() (bool, string) {
		state, err := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": p2.playerID})
		if err != nil {
			return false, err.Error()
		}
		s, ok := p2.self()
		return asInt(state["epoch"]) > asInt(before7["epoch"]) && ok && s.hp() == wantHP && s.updated.After(restartedAt),
			fmt.Sprintf("base %v client hp %d", state, s.hp())
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	after7, _ := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": p2.playerID})
	cellB2, _ := gm(ctx, 1002, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	selfNow, _ := p2.self()
	step("cell_crash", map[string]any{"p2_hp_before": wantHP, "p2_hp_after": selfNow.hp(), "epoch_before": before7["epoch"], "epoch_after": after7["epoch"],
		"owner_after": after7["owner_sid"], "restart_seconds": restartedAt.Sub(killedAt).Seconds(),
		"cell_b_monsters_respawned": cellB2["spawned"], "base_reenters": nodeStat(after7base(ctx), "Reenters")})

	// 9（第 1 项）. Base 进程重启后回到保存的位置：p5 的 Base 是只做 Base 的 sid 1004。p5 走到 (1200, 1500)（远离 spawn
	//    (2900, 1500)），等一次回写进 Player（快照位置随被接受的回写写进持久的 SavedPos*）；kill -9 sid 1004 再重启，p5
	//    重新登录，进场位置是保存的位置，不是 spawn。
	if *killBase != "" && *restartBase != "" {
		soft("base_restart", func() error {
			p5, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "p5", 1004, nonce)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := waitFor(ctx, 10*time.Second, "p5 sees itself", func() (bool, string) {
				_, ok := p5.self()
				return ok, p5.describe()
			}); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := p5.walkTo(ctx, 1200, 1500, 300); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := waitFor(ctx, 10*time.Second, "p5's position written back", func() (bool, string) {
				state, err := gm(ctx, 1004, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": p5.playerID})
				if err != nil {
					return false, err.Error()
				}
				return asInt(state["snapshot_seq"]) > 0 && dist(point{asInt(state["x"]), asInt(state["y"])}, point{1200, 1500}) <= 30, fmt.Sprintf("%v", state)
			}); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			time.Sleep(1500 * time.Millisecond) // 再过一次回写周期：保存的位置是停下之后的
			// 停下的位置：walkTo 越过目标才停（客户端看到的自己晚约 100ms，300 单位 / 秒时越过 25～40），比较对象是停下之后
			// Base 所知的位置（已随回写进快照），不是字面的 1200（v2.5 轮次里两次越过 40 而误报）。
			stopped, err := gm(ctx, 1004, "gm.scene.partition", map[string]any{"player_id": p5.playerID})
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			saved := point{asInt(stopped["x"]), asInt(stopped["y"])}
			if dist(saved, point{1200, 1500}) > 100 {
				return fmt.Errorf("p5 stopped at %v, want near (1200, 1500), far from the spawn", saved)
			}
			p5.raw.Close()
			if err := shell(*killBase); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("kill base: %w", err)
			}
			if err := shell(*restartBase); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("restart base: %w", err)
			}
			again, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "p5", 1004, nonce)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			defer again.raw.Close()
			var at point
			if err := waitFor(ctx, 20*time.Second, "p5 enters at its saved position", func() (bool, string) {
				s, ok := again.self()
				at = s.pos()
				return ok && dist(at, saved) <= 30, fmt.Sprintf("self %v ok %v saved %v", at, ok, saved)
			}); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			step("base_restart", map[string]any{"p5": p5.playerID, "entered_at": at, "saved": saved, "spawn": point{2900, 1500}})
			return nil
		}())
	}

	// 7b. 跨 Base 的队伍面板（第 4 项 = A）：p1（Base sid 1000）邀请 p6（Base sid 1004），两人彼此不在视野里（相距超过
	//     witness 半径）；入队后在各自的客户端里看见对方的 SceneActor（位置、HP），不论距离。p6 的 Base 被 kill -9 后
	//     3 个快照周期（1s × 3）没更新，p1 的面板移除 p6；重启、重新登录后队伍还在（成员表在 Team 实体上），面板恢复；
	//     p6 离队后两边的面板都移除对方；最后 p1 解散。
	if *killBase != "" && *restartBase != "" {
		soft("team_panel", teamPanel(ctx, accountsClient, nonce, p1))
		if progress, _ := evidence["team_panel"].(map[string]any); progress["removed_after_leave_ms"] != nil {
			expectable("team_roster_cross_base", teamRosterCrossBase(ctx, p1))
		}
	}

	// 8. 普通场景照常：sid 1003 没有分区配置，Move 照旧返回落定的位置，MoveIntent 返回 scene_not_partitioned。
	p4, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "p4", 1003, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	moved, err := p4.call(ctx, msgid.MsgMove, must(pb.MarshalMoveRequest(&pb.MoveRequest{X: 510, Y: 505})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if r, err := pb.UnmarshalMoveResponse(moved); err != nil || r.Code != 0 || r.X != 510 || r.Y != 505 {
		return fmt.Errorf("ordinary scene move: %v %+v", err, r)
	}
	intent, err := p4.call(ctx, msgid.MsgMoveIntent, must(pb.MarshalMoveIntentRequest(&pb.MoveIntentRequest{VX: 1})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if r, _ := pb.UnmarshalMoveIntentResponse(intent); r == nil || r.Code != 100025 {
		return fmt.Errorf("move_intent in an ordinary scene: want scene_not_partitioned, got %+v", r)
	}
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "p4 sees itself in the ordinary scene", func() (bool, string) {
		for id, o := range p4.snapshot() {
			if entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(id) == p4.playerID && o.pos() == (point{510, 505}) {
				return true, ""
			}
		}
		return false, fmt.Sprint(len(p4.snapshot()))
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	step("ordinary_scene", map[string]any{"p4": p4.playerID, "move": "ok", "move_intent": "scene_not_partitioned"})

	for _, c := range append(clients, p4) {
		if err := c.err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	baseEnd, _ := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	cellAEnd, _ := gm(ctx, 1001, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	cellBEnd, _ := gm(ctx, 1002, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	evidence["stats_end"] = map[string]any{"base_1000": baseEnd, "cell_1001": cellAEnd, "cell_1002": cellBEnd}
	evidence["stats_start"] = map[string]any{"base_1000": base0, "cell_1001": cellA0, "cell_1002": cellB0}
	for _, c := range append(clients, p4) {
		c.raw.Close()
	}
	if len(softFailures) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%d added check(s) failed: %s", len(softFailures), strings.Join(softFailures, "; "))
	}
	return nil
}

// team 发一个组队请求（invite / accept / leave / disband / info），答复的业务码非 0 时报错。
func (c *client) team(ctx context.Context, id uint32, payload []byte) (*pb.TeamResponse, error) {
	resp, err := c.call(ctx, id, payload)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	r, err := pb.UnmarshalTeamResponse(resp)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if r.Code != 0 {
		return r, fmt.Errorf("%s team msg %d: code %d %s", c.name, id, r.Code, r.Reason)
	}
	return r, nil
}

// actorOf 是客户端手里玩家 playerID 的 SceneActor（本进程没有登记实体种类：按 kind 与 unique 认）。
func (c *client) actorOf(playerID int64) (object, bool) {
	for id, o := range c.snapshot() {
		if entity.GetEntityKindFromID(id) == kindSceneActor && entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(id) == playerID {
			return o, true
		}
	}
	return object{}, false
}

// removedAt 是客户端最近一次删除玩家 playerID 的 SceneActor 的时间（since 之后）。
func (c *client) removedAt(playerID int64, since time.Time) (time.Time, bool) {
	for _, r := range c.removalsSince(since) {
		if entity.GetEntityKindFromID(r.ID) == kindSceneActor && entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(r.ID) == playerID {
			return r.At, true
		}
	}
	return time.Time{}, false
}

// teamPanel 是 7b 的演练（见 run 里的说明）。快照周期是 scene.partition.team.snapshot_every 的缺省 1s。
func teamPanel(ctx context.Context, accountsClient *svcaccount.BusClient, nonce string, p1 *client) error {
	const every = time.Second
	p6, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "p6", 1004, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 10*time.Second, "p6 sees itself", func() (bool, string) {
		_, ok := p6.self()
		return ok, p6.describe()
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	self1, ok := p1.self()
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("p1 does not hold itself: %s", p1.describe())
	}
	target := point{600, 1500}
	if dist(self1.pos(), target) < dist(self1.pos(), point{5400, 1500}) {
		target = point{5400, 1500}
	}
	if err := p6.walkTo(ctx, target.X, target.Y, 300); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	self1, _ = p1.self()
	self6, _ := p6.self()
	apart := dist(self1.pos(), self6.pos())
	if apart <= 1000 {
		return fmt.Errorf("p1 at %v and p6 at %v are %d apart, want them out of each other's view (> 1000)", self1.pos(), self6.pos(), apart)
	}
	if _, seen := p1.actorOf(p6.playerID); seen {
		return fmt.Errorf("p1 already holds p6 before the team: %s", p1.describe())
	}

	invited, err := p1.team(ctx, msgid.MsgTeamInvite, must(pb.MarshalTeamInviteRequest(&pb.TeamInviteRequest{Invitee: p6.playerID})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	joined, err := p6.team(ctx, msgid.MsgTeamAccept, must(pb.MarshalTeamAcceptRequest(&pb.TeamAcceptRequest{TeamID: invited.TeamID})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if joined.Leader != p1.playerID || len(joined.Members) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("after accept: %+v, want leader p1 and two members", joined)
	}
	seen := func(viewer, member *client, near point) error {
		return waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, viewer.name+" sees "+member.name+" in the team panel", func() (bool, string) {
			o, ok := viewer.actorOf(member.playerID)
			return ok && dist(o.pos(), near) <= 30 && o.hp() > 0, fmt.Sprintf("held %v %v", ok, o.fields)
		})
	}
	formed := time.Now()
	if err := seen(p1, p6, self6.pos()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := seen(p6, p1, self1.pos()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	panelAfter := time.Since(formed)
	o6, _ := p1.actorOf(p6.playerID)
	// 中间结果随做随记：后面的断言失败时 evidence.json 里仍有前面的观测。
	progress := map[string]any{"team": invited.TeamID, "p1": p1.playerID, "p6": p6.playerID, "apart": apart,
		"p1_sees_p6": o6.fields, "panel_after_ms": panelAfter.Milliseconds()}
	evidence["team_panel"] = progress

	// p6 的 Base 被 kill -9：快照停了，超过 3 个周期没更新，p1 的面板移除 p6（不早于最后一份快照之后 3 个周期）。
	p6.raw.Close()
	killed := time.Now()
	if err := shell(*killBase); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("kill base: %w", err)
	}
	// 最后一份快照最早在 kill 之前一个周期（加一拍 Base 心跳）发出：kill 之后约 3 - 1.1 个周期之内面板里还有它。
	time.Sleep(2*every - 400*time.Millisecond)
	if _, still := p1.actorOf(p6.playerID); !still {
		return fmt.Errorf("p6 left p1's panel %v after its base was killed, before 3 periods without a snapshot", time.Since(killed))
	}
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 6*time.Second, "p6 removed from p1's panel", func() (bool, string) {
		_, still := p1.actorOf(p6.playerID)
		return !still, ""
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	removedAt, _ := p1.removedAt(p6.playerID, killed)
	gone := removedAt.Sub(killed)
	progress["removed_after_kill_ms"] = gone.Milliseconds()
	if gone < 2*every-300*time.Millisecond || gone > 3*every+2*time.Second {
		return fmt.Errorf("p6 left p1's panel %v after its base was killed, want about 3 periods (%v)", gone, 3*every)
	}

	// 重启：队伍在 Team 实体上，p6 重新登录后它的 Base 从 Team 重读成员表，面板恢复。
	if err := shell(*restartBase); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("restart base: %w", err)
	}
	again, err := login(ctx, accountsClient, "p6", 1004, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer again.raw.Close()
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 20*time.Second, "p6 back in the world", func() (bool, string) {
		_, ok := again.self()
		return ok, again.describe()
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	info, err := again.team(ctx, msgid.MsgTeamInfo, must(pb.MarshalTeamInfoRequest(&pb.TeamInfoRequest{})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	progress["restored_members"] = info.Members
	if info.TeamID != invited.TeamID || len(info.Members) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("after p6's base restarted: team %+v, want team %d with both", info, invited.TeamID)
	}
	selfAgain, _ := again.self()
	if err := seen(p1, again, selfAgain.pos()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	self1, _ = p1.self()
	if err := seen(again, p1, self1.pos()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	progress["restored_after_restart"] = true

	// p6 离队：两边的面板都移除对方（经成员表通知，远早于 3 个周期的过期）。
	left := time.Now()
	if _, err := again.team(ctx, msgid.MsgTeamLeave, must(pb.MarshalTeamLeaveRequest(&pb.TeamLeaveRequest{}))); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "p6 removed from p1's panel after leaving", func() (bool, string) {
		_, still := p1.actorOf(again.playerID)
		return !still, ""
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	leftGone := time.Since(left)
	if err := waitFor(ctx, 5*time.Second, "p1 removed from p6's panel after p6 left", func() (bool, string) {
		_, still := again.actorOf(p1.playerID)
		return !still, ""
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	progress["removed_after_leave_ms"] = leftGone.Milliseconds()
	step("team_panel", progress)
	return nil
}

// teamRosterCrossBase：p6 在 sid 1004 上写过 Team（接受、离队）之后，p1 在 sid 1000 上再读 / 解散同一支队伍——两个 Base
// 交替写同一个 Remote 托管实体（共享模式）。见 FEATURE §13：本轮发现 sid 1000 内存里的旧副本不会重新加载
// （state version conflict），由 -expect-fail 标记，待维护者决定。
func teamRosterCrossBase(ctx context.Context, p1 *client) error {
	rest, err := p1.team(ctx, msgid.MsgTeamInfo, must(pb.MarshalTeamInfoRequest(&pb.TeamInfoRequest{})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(rest.Members) != 1 || rest.Members[0] != p1.playerID {
		return fmt.Errorf("after p6 left: %+v, want only p1", rest)
	}
	disbanded, err := p1.team(ctx, msgid.MsgTeamDisband, must(pb.MarshalTeamDisbandRequest(&pb.TeamDisbandRequest{})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	after, err := p1.team(ctx, msgid.MsgTeamInfo, must(pb.MarshalTeamInfoRequest(&pb.TeamInfoRequest{})))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if after.TeamID != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("after disband: %+v, want no team", after)
	}
	step("team_roster_cross_base", map[string]any{"members_after_leave": rest.Members, "disband_ver": disbanded.Ver})
	return nil
}

// pickMonster 选 p1 视野里满足位置条件、HP 最高的一只怪。
func pickMonster(c *client, where func(point) bool) int64 {
	var best int64
	bestHP := int64(-1)
	for id, o := range c.snapshot() {
		if entity.GetEntityKindFromID(id) != kindMonster || !where(o.pos()) {
			continue
		}
		if o.hp() > bestHP {
			best, bestHP = id, o.hp()
		}
	}
	return best
}

// findWalker 从两个 Cell 的区域表里找那只在走的怪（vx != 0 的 Real）：它的 ID、所在格的 sid 与 y。
func findWalker(ctx context.Context) (int64, int32, int64, error) {
	for _, sid := range []int32{1001, 1002} {
		entities, err := cellEntities(ctx, sid)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, 0, 0, err
		}
		for _, e := range entities {
			if e["role"] == "real" && asInt(e["vx"]) != 0 && entity.GetEntityKindFromID(asInt(e["id"])) == kindMonster {
				return asInt(e["id"]), sid, asInt(e["y"]), nil
			}
		}
	}
	return 0, 0, 0, errors.New("no walking monster in either cell")
}

// cellsStat 是两个 Cell 进程的某个 Node 计数之和。
func cellsStat(ctx context.Context, key string) int64 {
	var total int64
	for _, sid := range []int32{1001, 1002} {
		stats, err := gm(ctx, sid, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
		if err == nil {
			total += nodeStat(stats, key)
		}
	}
	return total
}

func after7base(ctx context.Context) map[string]any {
	stats, _ := gm(ctx, 1000, "gm.scene.partition", nil)
	return stats
}

func (c *client) createCount(id int64) int {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return c.creates[id]
}

// attackOf 是客户端从自己 SceneActor 的 mirror 看到的面板攻击（第 3 项 = A：伤害按它结算）。mirror 里没有这个字段时
// （没有面板）伤害是配置的 attack_damage；面板本身由 panel_level_up 一步严格核对（那里先要求 cell_max_hp 存在）。
func attackOf(c *client) int64 {
	s, _ := c.self()
	if v, ok := s.fields["cell_attack"]; ok {
		return asInt(v)
	}
	return *damage
}

// ownPlayer 是客户端手里自己的 Player（kind 是 Player、unique 是玩家 ID；分区场景里经 self 视图来，E4）。
func (c *client) ownPlayer() (object, bool) {
	for id, o := range c.snapshot() {
		if entity.GetEntityKindFromID(id) != kindSceneActor && entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(id) == c.playerID && o.ns == "player" {
			if _, hasExp := o.fields["exp"]; hasExp {
				return o, true
			}
		}
	}
	return object{}, false
}

// resultsFor 是 seq 在 [from, to] 之间的攻击结论推送。
func (c *client) resultsFor(from, to uint64) []*pb.AttackResultPush {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	var out []*pb.AttackResultPush
	for _, r := range c.results {
		if r.Seq >= from && r.Seq <= to {
			out = append(out, r)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// softFailures 收集追加检查（E4、第 1、2 项）的失败：一轮演练里全部跑完再报，修前一次就能看到每一项的红。
var softFailures []string

// expectable 是可以标成已知失败的追加检查（-expect-fail）：失败时打 “STEP <名字> EXPECTED-FAIL …”、不计入失败；标了却
// 通过时打 “STEP <名字> ok” 并提示去掉标记。没标时同 soft。
func expectable(name string, err error) {
	known := false
	for _, n := range strings.Split(*expectFail, ",") {
		known = known || strings.TrimSpace(n) == name
	}
	switch {
	case !known:
		soft(name, err)
	case err != nil:
		fmt.Printf("STEP %s EXPECTED-FAIL %v\n", name, err)
	default:
		fmt.Printf("STEP %s passed although marked -expect-fail; drop the mark\n", name)
	}
}

func soft(name string, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		softFailures = append(softFailures, name+": "+err.Error())
		fmt.Printf("STEP %s FAIL %v\n", name, err)
	}
}
